name: brigit
description: Brigit, the fire-angel hero: a young woman with long flowing bright red hair and a gold circlet, a gold breastplate and gold pauldrons, a short red skirt over gold-trimmed leather, gold greaves and brown boots, fiery orange-red feathered wings spread behind her on the screen-left side, and a golden sword with a blazing flaming blade in her LEFT hand
hands: the flaming sword stays in her left hand on the screen-right side and her right hand is an empty gloved fist at her side on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the flaming sword is lifted up over the head with its tip pointing up and back, the fiery wings half-raised behind her
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the flaming sword cocked behind the head with its blazing blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the flaming blade is level, pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the flaming blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance, the fiery wings spread behind her
strike.5: follow-through: the flaming blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, red hair and fiery wings trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the flaming sword lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the flaming sword arm thrown up and out), the fiery wings flaring
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the flaming sword dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the flaming sword arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the flaming sword lowering, the fiery wings drooping
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the flaming sword's tip resting on the ground, the empty right arm hanging, the wings folded down
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the flaming sword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the red hair spread out; the sword lies on the ground at the lower-right, its flames dying down; the fiery wings spread under her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the wings settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, the wings flat under her, the sword on the ground beside her with only a few small embers left on its blade
